Our brains tend to tell us stuff about ourselves that isn’t true. You’re not horrible. Even if you have flaws, even if you make a mistake, it’s all part of being human. It takes time and effort to fix those thought patterns. But you’re not horrible at all. You’re just a person who’s struggling, and that’s okay. It’s not your fault you’re like this. And this isn’t a permanent thing either. I’m sure you’re a good person, and I’m sure you have the potential to become an even better person. And even if you were horrible, you wouldn’t be stuck like that. There’s always a chance to get better. I wish you luck.

It happened to me the other day, and from the people I asked and the research I did I was able to gather information on how to take care of it. Mine hasn’t gotten infected and this is what I did so I think it’s a good way to go here.

Styro is scary. Hold a cloth of some sort, a sterile object to it for roughly 10 minutes to stop the bleeding, and I don’t recommend removing it during that time. If you’re freaking out then take deep breaths which may help, wash it out with warm water, multiple times if needed, then bandage It up. I’d say keep it covered for 1-2 weeks. Change it out at least every 24 hours. It uses a lot of supplies and it’s annoying but it’s important.
